input.summary: Ported stencil_1d.cu to SYCL 2020 in migrated/stencil_1d.dp.cpp. The port has no dpct includes, no dpct:: helpers, and no DPCT_* macros; the last compile with add_dpct_include=false succeeded with 0 errors and 0 warnings (build/candidate). Design: sycl::queue (in-order), sycl::malloc_device/sycl::free, a 1-D nd_range<1> of length threads in blocks of BLOCK_SIZE, a sycl::local_accessor<int,1> tile of BLOCK_SIZE+2*RADIUS, and sycl::group_barrier(item.get_group()) in place of __syncthreads. Halo loads and the zero-fill for gindex<RADIUS are unchanged, so the integer results should match the reference exactly. Caveat: I have no tool that executes the binary, so the output-vs-reference comparison was not run; correctness is argued from the unchanged logic, not measured.
